en: Changed cloud session and Remote Control MCP connectors to negotiate MCP protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on installs that fetch no flags; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
zh: 变更云端 session 和远程控制的 MCP connector，在未获取任何 flag 的安装上默认协商 MCP 协议版本 2026-07-28；设置 `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` 可退出该行为
